title: The Umbrella Wide Enough
youtube_title: The Umbrella Wide Enough | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Saving a place is a way of saying you belong.
summary: At a meadow gate where games start, Idris is just outside the fun, close to an umbrella that could tilt. Yael changes the seating, the rules, or the pace so Idris has a real place, not a prize announced out loud. Mr. Ade lets the children solve it.
